comment: Shared conformance vectors for the access model's permission decision: engine/server/accesswrite.go (accessSet.holdsUnder) and client/src/access.ts (canAt) must reach the same verdict on every case both can decide. A caller holds a permission at a row when it holds it at the workspace root, at the row itself, or at the row the row's access_parent reference names. `access` maps each permission the caller holds to where: `root` for the workspace root, `anchors` as entity name to row keys; null means no summary has reached the client, which only the client can be missing. `parent` is what the row's access_parent names: an object for a row below another row, null for a row whose entity has no access parent or whose reference is unset, and the string "unknown" for a row the client does not hold, which the server never lacks. `want` is "yes", "no" or "unknown"; the engine checks the cases whose `access` is not null and whose `parent` is not "unknown", where "yes" means it holds the permission.

cases.name: a permission held at the root reaches every row
the root reaches a row with no parent
the root reaches a row the client does not hold
a permission held at the parent reaches the row
a permission held at another parent does not
a permission held at the row itself reaches it
an unset parent never falls back to the root
an anchor of another entity with the same key does not reach the row
another permission held at the parent does not count
a permission held nowhere answers no
a row the client does not hold is unknown when only a parent could reach it
a row anchor answers even for a row the client does not hold
